title: Before We Forget Kindness (Book 5 of 5) by Toshikazu Kawaguchi
description: Before We Forget Kindness invites readers back to the quiet, magical café where time travel is possible—if you follow the rules and return before the coffee gets cold. In this gentle and emotional installment, visitors arrive carrying regrets, unresolved feelings, and hopes tied to compassion and forgiveness. Through brief journeys to the past, the story reflects on everyday kindness, human connections, and the small moments that shape our lives. Each chapter offers warmth and quiet wisdom, reminding us that while the past cannot be changed, understanding and empathy can heal the heart. Written with simplicity and emotional depth, the novel celebrates love, patience, and the power of being kind. Comforting and reflective, it’s perfect for readers who enjoy heartfelt stories that linger softly long after the final page.

title: The Alchemist by Paulo Coelho
description:
The Alchemist Is An Inspiring And Timeless Novel That Has Touched Millions Of Readers Worldwide. It Tells The Story Of Santiago, A Young Andalusian Shepherd Boy Who Dreams Of Finding A Hidden Treasure Near The Egyptian Pyramids. Guided By His Heart, Mysterious Omens, And The Wisdom Of People He Meets Along The Way, Santiago Embarks On A Journey That Becomes Much More Than A Search For Material Wealthit Turns Into A Quest For Self-Discovery, Purpose, And Personal Destiny.

With Poetic Storytelling And Universal Lessons, Paulo Coelho Explores Themes Of:

Following One Dreams (personal Legendï¿½)

The Power Of Listening To Your Heart

Faith, Courage, And Perseverance

The Idea That The Universe Helps You When You Truly Want Something

Blending Spiritual Wisdom, Adventure, And Philosophy, The Alchemist Encourages Readers To Trust In Life Journey And Believe In The Magic Of Pursuing Their Dreams.

Perfect For Anyone Seeking Motivation, Inspiration, Or A Fresh Perspective On Life, The Alchemist Is More Than A Novelit A Guide To Finding Your Own Path.

title: Before I Knew I Loved You By Toshikazu Kawaguchi
description: Step into a magical Tokyo café where a single cup of coffee offers the chance to travel through time. In this heartwarming novel, four people are given an opportunity to revisit important moments with their loved ones. Through stories of regret, hope, forgiveness, and love, they discover the power of human connection. Each journey reveals emotions left unspoken and relationships that deserve a second chance. As always, there is one important rule—return before the coffee gets cold. Filled with warmth and gentle wisdom, this novel explores how memories can heal the heart. Toshikazu Kawaguchi beautifully blends magical realism with everyday emotions. A touching story about love, family, and the moments that shape our lives. Perfect for readers who enjoy emotional and uplifting fiction.

title: As Long as the Lemon Trees Grow by Zoulfa Katouh
description: As Long as the Lemon Trees Grow is a deeply emotional novel set during the Syrian civil war, exploring love, survival, and hope amid unimaginable loss. The story follows Salama, a young pharmacy student turned volunteer medic, who struggles to keep going after losing her family to the war. As violence closes in, Salama is torn between staying to help others and escaping to safety. Through heartbreak, resilience, and unexpected love, the novel captures the human cost of war and the strength found in compassion. Written with raw honesty and lyrical emotion, it brings readers into the realities faced by civilians in conflict zones. Powerful and unforgettable, this book is a moving testament to courage, grief, and the will to survive.

title: Hippie by Paulo Coelho
description:
Hippie by Paulo Coelho is an evocative, semi-autobiographical novel capturing the spirit of the transformative 1970s.
From the celebrated author of The Alchemist comes an intimate personal journey of spiritual exploration and self-discovery.
Follows young Brazilian aspiring writer Paulo, sporting long hair and seeking peace, as he travels across Europe.
In Amsterdam, he crosses paths with Karla, a free-spirited Dutch woman, and they board the legendary 'Magic Bus' to Nepal.
Takes readers on an extraordinary overland expedition through vibrant cultures, spiritual traditions, and exotic landscapes.
Reflects deeply on the dreams, philosophical ideals, and passionate peaceful protests of the global counterculture era.
Weaves timeless wisdom about love, destiny, human connection, and having the courage to break free from societal conformity.
Lyrical prose brings the sounds, smells, colors, and revolutionary optimism of the 1970s hippie trail vividly alive.
A soulful, introspective narrative that speaks directly to free spirits, adventurous backpackers, and spiritual seekers.
An enchanting literary voyage that reminds readers to embrace their own inner calling and walk the road less traveled.

title: The Forty Rules of Love by Elif Shafak
description: The Forty Rules of Love is a deeply moving novel that weaves together two parallel stories—one set in contemporary times and the other in the 13th century—exploring love, faith, and spiritual awakening. The modern narrative follows Ella Rubinstein, a woman whose ordinary life begins to change after she reads a manuscript about the legendary bond between Rumi and his spiritual mentor, Shams of Tabriz. Through Shams’ forty rules, the novel reveals profound insights about love that transcends ego, religion, and fear. As Ella’s inner journey mirrors Rumi’s transformation, the story beautifully illustrates how love can challenge beliefs and reshape destinies. Poetic, philosophical, and emotionally rich, the novel celebrates divine love, self-discovery, and human connection. Inspiring and timeless, it invites readers to open their hearts to love in all its forms.

title: Before Your Memory Fades (Book 3 of 5) by Toshikazu Kawaguchi
description: Before Your Memory Fades takes readers back to the enchanting café where time travel is possible, but only under strict and heartbreaking rules. In this emotional continuation, new characters visit the café carrying regrets, love, and memories they fear losing forever. As the coffee is poured, they are given one brief chance to revisit the past—not to change it, but to understand it. The story gently explores themes of aging, memory, family bonds, and unspoken feelings. Each chapter delivers quiet emotional impact, reminding readers of the value of presence and human connection. Warm, reflective, and deeply comforting, this novel is a beautiful meditation on love, remembrance, and the moments we hold closest to our hearts.

title: Tales from the Café (Book 2 of 5) by Toshikazu Kawaguchi
description: Tales from the Cafe continues the beloved story set in the quiet Tokyo café where customers can travel back in time—if they follow the strict rules and return before the coffee gets cold. This installment introduces new visitors, each carrying regrets, love, and unanswered questions from their past. Through brief yet emotional journeys, the novel explores themes of family, friendship, forgiveness, and the bonds that connect people across time. The gentle storytelling highlights how even small moments can hold deep meaning. Written with warmth and simplicity, the book offers comfort, reflection, and emotional depth. Thoughtful and soothing, Tales from the Cafe is perfect for readers who enjoy heart-touching stories about human connections and second chances.

title: No Longer Human by Osamu Dazai
description: No Longer Human is a haunting and deeply personal novel that explores alienation, self-destruction, and the struggle to feel human in a world governed by social expectations. The story follows Ōba Yōzō, a man who feels incapable of understanding or connecting with others, masking his despair behind humor and false charm. As his life spirals through addiction, failed relationships, and emotional collapse, the novel exposes the quiet agony of isolation and shame. Written in a confessional style, the narrative feels intensely raw and autobiographical, reflecting Osamu Dazai’s own inner turmoil. The book examines identity, mental health, and the fear of being truly seen. Dark, honest, and unsettling, No Longer Human is a powerful psychological classic that resonates deeply with readers who have felt disconnected or misunderstood.

title: The Vegetarian by Han Kang
description: The Vegetarian is a haunting and provocative novel that explores identity, control, and the quiet violence hidden within ordinary lives. When Yeong-hye abruptly decides to stop eating meat after disturbing dreams, her simple choice triggers intense reactions from her family and society. As pressure mounts, her refusal becomes an act of resistance against conformity, patriarchy, and bodily control. Told through shifting perspectives, the novel delves into obsession, desire, and the fragile boundary between sanity and madness. Han Kang’s spare, poetic prose creates an unsettling atmosphere that lingers long after reading. Disturbing yet deeply reflective, the story examines autonomy, repression, and the cost of defying social norms. Winner of the Man Booker International Prize, The Vegetarian is a powerful, unforgettable work of modern literary fiction.

title: Midnight's Children by Salman Rushdie
description: Midnight’s Children is a groundbreaking novel that blends history, fantasy, and politics to tell the story of modern India through the life of one extraordinary boy. Born at the exact moment India gains independence, Saleem Sinai discovers he is mysteriously linked to hundreds of other children born in the same hour, each gifted with unique powers. As Saleem’s personal life unfolds alongside major historical events, the novel explores identity, memory, fate, and the impact of history on individuals. Rich in symbolism, humor, and imaginative storytelling, the narrative captures the chaos and complexity of a newly born nation. Salman Rushdie’s lyrical prose and inventive structure redefine how history can be told through fiction. Epic, bold, and unforgettable, Midnight’s Children is a landmark work of world literature that continues to inspire and challenge readers.

title: Too Good to Be True by Carola Lovering
description: Too Good to Be True by Prajakta Koli is a heartfelt, charming contemporary fiction novel about self-discovery, grief, healing, and second chances. The story follows Kareena Thakar, whose perfectly planned life is shaken after a series of unexpected events. As she navigates family pressures, personal loss, and complicated relationships, Kareena slowly learns to rebuild her confidence and embrace who she is becoming. Warm, relatable, and emotionally honest, the book explores identity, love, and the courage it takes to start over.

title: Before the Coffee Gets Cold (Book 1 of 5) by Toshikazu Kawaguchi
description: Before the Coffee Gets Cold is a beautifully touching story set in a small café where customers can travel back in time—under very specific rules. The most important rule is simple yet heartbreaking: you must return to the present before the coffee gets cold. Through a series of emotional encounters, the novel explores love, regret, forgiveness, and the things people wish they had said. Each visit into the past reveals that while time travel cannot change the present, it can change the heart. Written with simplicity and warmth, the story gently reflects on human connections and second chances. Emotional, comforting, and thought-provoking, this novel is perfect for readers who enjoy meaningful stories with a touch of magic and deep emotional impact.

title: Never Let Me Go by Kazuo Ishiguro
description: Never Let Me Go is a haunting and deeply emotional novel about love, memory, and the fragile nature of human existence. Told through the voice of Kathy H., the story follows her childhood and adolescence at a seemingly idyllic English boarding school, where students grow up under mysterious circumstances. As the truth about their purpose in society slowly becomes clear, the characters must face a fate they cannot escape. The novel explores friendship, jealousy, and the quiet desperation of wanting more time and meaning in life. Kazuo Ishiguro’s restrained and gentle prose makes the tragedy feel even more powerful. Subtle, heartbreaking, and thought-provoking, this novel questions what it truly means to be human and how we find dignity in the face of loss.

title: Men Without Women by Haruki Murakami
description: Men Without Women is a beautifully melancholic collection of seven short stories exploring loneliness, longing, and the quiet emotional worlds of men who find themselves without the women they once loved—or wished they could love. Murakami blends his signature surreal touches with deep psychological insight, creating characters who linger in the reader’s mind long after their stories end. Each tale captures the ache of solitude, the mystery of human connection, and the strange ways the heart tries to heal. Poetic, haunting, and deeply human, this collection showcases Murakami at his most intimate and reflective. A must-read for anyone drawn to layered, emotional storytelling.

title: Before We Say Goodbye (Book 4 of 5) by Toshikazu Kawaguchi
description: Before We Say Goodbye returns readers to the quiet, magical café where time travel is possible—if you follow the rules and return before the coffee gets cold. In this moving installment, new visitors arrive carrying regrets, unanswered questions, and words left unsaid. Through brief journeys to the past, the story explores love, loss, forgiveness, and the courage it takes to face emotional truths. Each chapter gently reminds us that while we cannot change what has already happened, we can change how we carry it within us. Written with warmth and simplicity, the novel offers comfort and reflection in equal measure. Tender, emotional, and deeply human, this book is perfect for readers who cherish heartfelt stories about connections, healing, and letting go.

title: After Dark by Haruki Murakami
description: After Dark is a haunting, dreamlike novel set over the course of one strange night in Tokyo. Haruki Murakami follows multiple characters whose lives briefly intersect—from Mari, a quiet student spending the night in a café, to her sister Eri, who lies in a disturbing, unexplained sleep. As the city slips deeper into darkness, surreal encounters unfold, hinting at hidden fears, unspoken desires, and the thin veil between reality and the subconscious. Murakami blends mystery, philosophy, and magical realism to create a hypnotic portrait of loneliness and human connection. Lyrical, eerie, and thought-provoking, After Dark leaves readers questioning what is real and what lies just beneath the surface.

title: The Book Thief by Markus Zusak
description:
The Book Thief by Markus Zusak is a globally acclaimed historical fiction classic set in Nazi-era Germany.
Uniquely and hauntingly narrated by the voice of Death, this unforgettable story follows young foster girl Liesel Meminger.
Discover how Liesel discovers solace, hope, and humanity by stealing forbidden books and sharing them with her neighbors.
Depicts the profound bond she develops with her foster parents and the courageous Jewish fist-fighter hidden in their basement.
A deeply moving examination of human resilience, moral courage, and compassionate defiance against fascist tyranny.
Celebrates the immortal power of words, literature, and storytelling to sustain the human spirit through darkness.
Markus Zusak writes with poetic beauty, heartbreaking tenderness, and astonishingly vivid literary imagery.
An enduring international bestseller praised by educators, literary critics, and millions of passionate readers worldwide.
Captures the shocking contrast between man's devastating cruelty and the boundless capacity for human kindness.
A timeless, tear-jerking masterpiece that holds an essential, treasured place in modern world literature.

title: Sputnik Sweetheart by Haruki Murakami
description: Sputnik Sweetheart is a haunting and introspective novel about unrequited love, loneliness, and the invisible distances between people. The story follows K, a young writer deeply in love with Sumire, an eccentric aspiring author who, in turn, falls for an older woman named Miu. As their relationships intertwine, a mysterious disappearance pulls the narrative into surreal and emotional territory. Murakami blends reality with dreamlike elements to explore identity, desire, and emotional isolation. Quiet yet powerful, the novel reflects on the pain of loving someone who cannot love you back. Poetic, strange, and deeply moving, Sputnik Sweetheart is perfect for readers who enjoy thought-provoking literary fiction with emotional depth.

title: The Humans by Matt Haig
description:
The Humans by Matt Haig is an extraordinary, heartwarming, and humorously philosophical novel about life on Earth.
An alien entity from an advanced civilization is sent to Earth to erase a breakthrough mathematical proof.
Taking over the body of Cambridge mathematics professor Andrew Martin, the alien initially views humans with disdain.
As he navigates human relationships, family dynamics, music, food, and romantic love, his perspective completely transforms.
Matt Haig masterfully combines sharp comedic wit, emotional poignancy, and profound existential reflections on life.
Explores what it truly means to be human—navigating grief, vulnerability, mortal beauty, and the courage to love.
Features a celebrated, touching list of life advice for humans that resonates deeply with readers of all generations.
An internationally acclaimed bestseller adored by fans of speculative fiction, literary drama, and uplifting comedy.
Inspires readers to look at everyday life with renewed wonder, gratitude, compassion, and emotional openness.
A brilliantly charming and deeply moving novel that will make you fall in love with humanity all over again.

title: Kafka on the Shore by Haruki Murakami
description: Kafka on the Shore is a mesmerizing blend of magical realism, mystery, and philosophical storytelling. The novel follows two parallel journeys: Kafka, a fifteen-year-old runaway searching for truth and identity, and Nakata, an elderly man with a mysterious ability to talk to cats. As their worlds gradually intertwine, strange events unfold—fish rain from the sky, memories shift, and the boundary between dreams and reality dissolves. Murakami explores fate, consciousness, love, and the hidden connections that bind all things. Haunting, symbolic, and deeply imaginative, Kafka on the Shore is a novel that lingers in the mind long after the final page, inviting endless interpretation.

title: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle by Haruki Murakami
description:
The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle is one of Haruki Murakami's most celebrated novels, blending mystery, surrealism, and psychological depth into an unforgettable literary masterpiece. The story follows Toru Okada, whose quiet and ordinary life takes an unexpected turn after his cat disappears, followed by the mysterious disappearance of his wife.
As Toru searches for answers, he encounters a series of strange and unforgettable characters, each revealing pieces of a larger mystery that blurs the line between reality and imagination. The novel weaves together themes of love, loneliness, memory, war, identity, and the hidden forces that shape human lives.
Rich with symbolism and dreamlike storytelling, Murakami creates a mesmerizing world where everyday life merges with the extraordinary. His lyrical writing and thought-provoking narrative invite readers to explore the complexities of the human mind and the mysteries of existence.
Widely regarded as a modern literary classic, The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle is perfect for readers who enjoy philosophical fiction, psychological mysteries, and beautifully crafted stories that linger long after the final page. It is an essential read for fans of contemporary world literature and Haruki Murakami's unique storytelling.

title: The 4-Hour Workweek by Timothy Ferriss
description:
The 4-Hour Workweek by Timothy Ferriss is the groundbreaking manifesto that launched the global lifestyle design revolution.
Learn how to escape 9-to-5 corporate drudgery, live anywhere in the world, and join the ranks of the New Rich.
Master the DEAL framework: Definition, Elimination, Automation, and Liberation, to multiply your hourly income.
Discover practical systems for radical time management, selective information consumption, and outsourcing to virtual assistants.
Shows how to create automated, scalable cash-flow businesses that generate consistent passive income around the clock.
Advocates replacing traditional delayed retirement with exciting mini-retirements throughout your active adult life.
Packed with actionable negotiation scripts, digital tools, tax strategies, and real-life lifestyle redesign case studies.
Empowers freelancers, remote workers, startup founders, and corporate professionals to take back control of their time.
A New York Times multi-year bestseller that fundamentally changed modern perceptions of work, freedom, and mobility.
The quintessential guide for working smarter, traveling the world, and designing a life tailored to your personal dreams.

title: The Psychology of Money by Morgan Housel
description: The Psychology Of Money By Morgan Housel Explores How People'S Emotions, Behaviors, And Attitudes Shape Their Financial Decisions More Than Knowledge Or Logic. The Book Uses Real-Life Stories To Show That Wealth Is Not About How Much You Earn, But How You Manage, Save, And Think About Money. It Highlights The Importance Of Patience, Long-Term Thinking, And Avoiding Comparison. Housel Explains That Financial Success Comes From Consistency, Self-Control, And Understanding Your Own Values. Overall, It Teaches That Money Decisions Are Driven By Psychology, Not Just Math.

title: Trading in the Zone by Mark Douglas
description:
Master your mindset—master the markets.
Trading in the Zone is the definitive guide to trading psychology. Mark Douglas explains why most traders fail—not due to strategy, but emotions. Learn how to think in probabilities, eliminate fear and hesitation, and execute trades with consistency and discipline. Clear, practical, and mindset-shifting—this book is essential for traders who want long-term success and emotional control. 📈🧠📘

title: The 80/20 Principle by Richard Koch
description: The 80/20 Principle reveals one of the most powerful ideas in productivity and success: that 80% of results come from just 20% of efforts. Richard Koch explains how to identify the small actions that produce the biggest impact—whether in business, work, relationships, or daily life. Using real examples and practical strategies, he shows how to simplify your workload, double your efficiency, and focus on what truly matters. The book challenges traditional thinking and empowers you to remove waste, eliminate distractions, and design a life built around high-value activities. Clear, insightful, and transformative, it is a must-read for anyone seeking smarter—not harder—success.

title: Rich Dad Poor Dad by Robert T. Kiyosaki
description: Rich Dad Poor Dad is a transformative personal finance classic that challenges traditional beliefs about money, work, and success. Through the contrasting lessons of his “rich dad” and “poor dad,” Robert Kiyosaki explains how the wealthy think differently — focusing on assets, financial education, and long-term wealth-building rather than job security and paychecks. The book breaks down complex financial ideas into simple, easy-to-understand concepts, empowering readers to rethink earning, investing, and managing money. Inspiring and practical, it encourages financial independence, smarter decision-making, and a mindset shift that can change your future. A must-read for anyone wanting to take control of their financial life.

title: The Diary of a CEO by Steven Bartlett
description:
The Diary Of A Ceo By Steven Bartlett
This Book Shares Personal Insights, Lessons, And Reflections From Entrepreneur Steven Bartlett. It Covers Entrepreneurship, Personal Growth, Leadership, And Mental Health, Blending Storytelling With Practical Advice.
Key Message: Success Comes From Self-Awareness, Discipline, And Learning From Failures.

title: Think and Grow Rich by Napoleon Hill
description: Think and Grow Rich by Napoleon Hill is one of the most influential self-help and success books ever written. Based on decades of interviews with the world’s most successful people, Hill reveals the timeless principles behind wealth creation, personal achievement, and unstoppable motivation. The book teaches you how to use the power of your mind, clarity of purpose, and focused action to transform your life. With lessons on desire, faith, persistence, imagination, and decision-making, Hill provides a blueprint for turning dreams into reality. Even after more than 80 years, its ideas remain powerful, practical, and life-changing. A must-read for anyone who wants to build success—financially, professionally, and personally.

title: I Don't Love You Anymore by Rithvik Singh
description: I Don’t Love You Anymore is an emotionally gripping contemporary romance about heartbreak, healing, and rediscovering oneself. When love falls apart without warning, the protagonist is forced to confront painful truths, rebuild from the ground up, and learn what it truly means to let go. Raw, relatable, and beautifully written, this story captures the bittersweet journey from broken love to personal strength. Perfect for readers who enjoy intense emotions, realistic relationships, and heartfelt storytelling.

title: Rework by Jason Fried & David Heinemeier Hansson
description: Rework challenges traditional business thinking and shows a smarter, simpler way to build and run a successful company. The authors argue against long meetings, excessive planning, and hustle culture, promoting clarity, focus, and meaningful work instead. Through short, powerful chapters, the book offers practical advice on productivity, marketing, hiring, and decision-making. It encourages entrepreneurs to start small, move fast, and ignore outdated rules that slow progress. Written in a bold and refreshing tone, the ideas are easy to apply in real-world business situations. Insightful and unconventional, Rework is perfect for founders, freelancers, and professionals who want to work better, not longer, and build businesses that actually make sense.

title: The Way of the Wolf by Jordan Belfort
description:
The Way of the Wolf by Jordan Belfort breaks down the legendary Straight Line Sales and Persuasion System.
Written by the real-life 'Wolf of Wall Street,' this book reveals the exact psychological tactics behind multi-million-dollar sales.
Master the science of tonal inflection, body language, charisma, and building instantaneous rapport with prospective clients.
Learn how to systematically shorten sales cycles, overcome objections smoothly, and close deals with consistent confidence.
Explains the vital 'Three Tens' rule: establishing absolute client certainty in your product, yourself, and your organization.
Supplies actionable word-for-word scripts, phone pitching frameworks, and strategic objection-handling tactics.
Designed for sales executives, corporate leaders, real estate agents, entrepreneurs, and professional consultants.
Shows how to utilize ethical influence and high-stakes negotiation techniques to produce mutually beneficial commercial outcomes.
Helps professionals eliminate sales call reluctance, maintain control of every conversation, and boost conversion rates.
The definitive, high-energy sales training manual for anyone seeking to master persuasion and achieve elite income.

title: The Richest Man in Babylon by George S. Clason
description: The Richest Man in Babylon by George S. Clason is a classic guide to building wealth, mastering money, and achieving financial success through simple, timeless principles. Told through powerful parables set in ancient Babylon, the book teaches essential lessons on saving, investing, budgeting, and growing your income—wisdom that remains relevant even today. Each story highlights the importance of discipline, smart decision-making, and consistent action. Clear, inspiring, and easy to understand, it offers practical financial guidance for readers of all ages. Whether you're just starting your financial journey or looking to strengthen your money habits, this book provides a foundation for lasting prosperity.

title: The 22 Immutable Laws of Marketing by Al Ries & Jack Trout
description:
The 22 Immutable Laws of Marketing by Al Ries and Jack Trout is the world's most enduring classic business strategy book.
Distills decades of high-level branding consultancy into twenty-two unbreakable principles for market dominance.
Introduces foundational concepts like the Law of Leadership, the Law of the Category, and the Law of the Mind.
Explains why positioning, perception, and focused messaging consistently triumph over product quality alone.
Examines real-world corporate triumphs and blunders from global giants like IBM, Coca-Cola, General Motors, and Xerox.
Teaches entrepreneurs and corporate executives how to avoid fatal traps like line extension and brand dilution.
Offers timeless business wisdom that remains directly applicable in today's digital, social, and e-commerce landscapes.
Written in a brisk, razor-sharp, and witty style that makes complex marketing concepts instantly memorable.
Essential reading for marketing managers, startup founders, MBA students, and business leaders worldwide.
A legendary corporate playbook that provides the strategic blueprint for building world-class, enduring brands.

title: The Lean Startup by Eric Ries
description: The Lean Startup revolutionizes the way modern businesses are built by teaching entrepreneurs how to test ideas quickly, measure what truly matters, and pivot when necessary. Eric Ries introduces the Lean methodology—validated learning, rapid experimentation, and continuous innovation—to help startups avoid wasting time, money, and effort. Through real-world examples and practical tools, the book shows how companies of any size can create products customers actually want. It emphasizes agility, adaptability, and smart decision-making in a fast-changing world. Clear, insightful, and transformative, The Lean Startup has become the foundational guide for entrepreneurs, leaders, and innovators everywhere.

title: Zero to One by Peter Thiel
description: Zero To One" By Peter Thiel Focuses On How To Build Innovative Startups That Create Truly New Things Instead Of Copying Existing Ideas. Thiel Emphasizes Thinking Independently, Developing Unique Value, And Building Monopolies Through Innovation Rather Than Competition. The Book Encourages Entrepreneurs To Go From zero To One Creating Something Original That Changes The World.

title: One Up on Wall Street by Peter Lynch
description: One Up On Wall Street is a classic investing guide that shows everyday investors how to beat professional fund managers by using simple observation and common sense. Legendary investor Peter Lynch explains how opportunities for great investments often appear in daily life—through products, services, and companies we already understand. The book breaks down how to identify promising stocks, evaluate businesses, and avoid common investing mistakes. Lynch emphasizes long-term thinking, patience, and doing your own research instead of chasing market trends. Written in a clear, engaging style, complex ideas are made easy for beginners and practical for experienced investors. Insightful, timeless, and highly readable, this book is essential for anyone who wants to invest confidently and intelligently in the stock market.

title: Lights Out by Thomas Gryta & Ted Mann
description: Lights Out is a dark, addictive romance that dives into obsession, desire, and the thin line between fear and attraction. The story follows a dangerous, morally grey male lead whose presence is as unsettling as it is irresistible. When the female protagonist becomes entangled in his world, what begins as tension quickly turns into a psychologically charged connection filled with control, secrecy, and temptation. As emotions intensify, trust becomes fragile and boundaries blur, forcing both characters to confront their darkest impulses. The novel explores power dynamics, emotional vulnerability, and the consequences of toxic attraction. Intense, provocative, and unapologetically dark, Lights Out is perfect for readers who crave twisted romance, high emotional stakes, and characters who live in the shadows.

title: Make Epic Money by Ankur Warikoo
description:
Make Epic Money by Ankur Warikoo is a straightforward, empowering personal finance guide for ambitious modern earners.
Following his runaway bestsellers Do Epic Shit and Get Epic Shit Done, Warikoo tackles wealth building with clarity.
Learn how to manage, invest, and compound your earnings effectively while avoiding common financial scams and traps.
Demystifies mutual funds, stock investing, emergency funds, debt clearance, real estate, and long-term asset allocation.
Explores the emotional psychology behind financial decisions, addressing childhood scarcity mindsets and lifestyle inflation.
Filled with candid personal anecdotes about early financial failures, hard-earned money lessons, and ultimate success.
Provides practical financial health formulas, expenditure frameworks, and budgeting templates designed for easy use.
Written in a conversational, relatable style that speaks directly to students, salaried professionals, and entrepreneurs.
Helps readers break free from financial anxiety, build multiple income streams, and achieve true financial freedom.
A comprehensive, indispensable financial playbook for creating enduring multi-generational wealth and security.

title: Never Split the Difference by Chris Voss
description:
Never Split the Difference by Chris Voss reveals field-tested negotiation techniques from a former lead FBI hostage negotiator.
Breaks down high-stakes communication strategies into practical principles anyone can apply in business and daily life.
Master the power of Tactical Empathy, mirroring phrases, and tone modulation to disarm hostile or resistant counterparts.
Learn how to use calibrated open-ended questions that gently push others to solve problems on your behalf.
Explains why seeking an immediate 'Yes' can be dangerous and how getting to 'No' unlocks true collaborative negotiation.
Uncover hidden 'Black Swans'—subtle pieces of information that can completely flip negotiating leverage in your favor.
Filled with thrilling, real-world hostage standoff stories that illustrate psychological concepts with dramatic clarity.
Apply elite persuasion strategies to salary reviews, corporate sales, real estate deals, and interpersonal conflicts.
Endorsed by corporate executives, legal professionals, entrepreneurs, and sales champions across the globe.
The definitive, game-changing playbook for gaining a decisive upper hand while maintaining mutual respect.

title: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets by John J. Murphy
description:
Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets by John J. Murphy is globally hailed as the 'Bible of Technical Analysis.'
The definitive, comprehensive textbook covering every critical aspect of chart analysis and trading system construction.
Master essential charting tools: candlestick patterns, trendlines, moving averages, support and resistance, and breakouts.
Provides deep insights into momentum oscillators, volume indicators, market breadth, and intermarket correlation analysis.
Breaks down advanced forecasting models including Elliott Wave Theory, Fibonacci retracement levels, and time cycles.
Written in a lucid, authoritative style accompanied by hundreds of real-world charts, diagrams, and historical market setups.
Serves as the primary study resource for CMT (Chartered Market Technician) certification and Wall Street analysts.
Equally applicable across diverse asset classes: stocks, commodities, futures, options, forex, and cryptocurrency.
Emphasizes disciplined risk management, stop-loss discipline, and objective rule-based trading system development.
The foundational reference work that every professional trader and serious financial market participant must own.

title: Tamil Edition - The Psychology of Money | Morgan Housel
description:
The Psychology of Money – Tamil Edition by Morgan Housel explores the emotional and behavioral side of money, wealth, saving, spending, and investing.

Rather than focusing only on financial formulas or technical investment strategies, the book explains how our personal experiences, emotions, habits, and beliefs influence the way we handle money. Through simple stories and practical lessons, Morgan Housel shows why financial success is often influenced by behavior and decision-making as much as by knowledge.

This Tamil edition makes these valuable financial lessons accessible to Tamil-speaking readers. It is suitable for anyone looking to develop better money habits, understand wealth, and make more thoughtful financial decisions.

title: Tamil Edition - Rich Dad Poor Dad | Robert T. Kiyosaki
description:
Rich Dad Poor Dad – Tamil Edition by Robert T. Kiyosaki is a bestselling personal finance book that introduces readers to fundamental ideas about money, wealth building, financial independence, and investing.

The book presents lessons inspired by the contrasting financial philosophies of two father figures: the author’s biological father, referred to as his “Poor Dad,” and the father of his best friend, referred to as his “Rich Dad.” Through their different approaches to money and work, Kiyosaki explains how financial thinking can influence long-term financial outcomes.

This Tamil edition makes the book accessible to Tamil-speaking readers who want to understand personal finance concepts in a simple and engaging format.

title: The Hard Thing About Hard Things by Ben Horowitz
description: The Hard Thing About Hard Things is a brutally honest and practical guide to entrepreneurship from Ben Horowitz, one of Silicon Valley’s most respected founders and investors. Instead of offering clichés or easy advice, Horowitz dives into the painful realities of building and leading a company—layoffs, crises, tough decisions, self-doubt, and the pressure of being a CEO when everything is on the line. Drawing from his own experiences building and saving companies, he shares the lessons he learned the hard way, including how to lead through chaos, manage people, and make impossible choices. Direct, wise, and full of real-world insights, this book is essential reading for entrepreneurs, leaders, and anyone navigating the challenges of growth and responsibility.

title: The Disciplined Trader by Mark Douglas
description:
The Disciplined Trader: Developing Winning Attitudes by Mark Douglas is a foundational masterpiece of market psychology.
Authored by one of Wall Street's most respected trading coaches, this book proves that mindset outweighs market predictions.
Examines the hidden emotional traps, fear-based behaviors, and cognitive biases that cause traders to sabotage profits.
Teaches how to transition from anxiety-driven impulse trading to a calm, disciplined, and systematic execution mindset.
Learn how to view market movements probabilistically, accept losses without emotional devastation, and eliminate revenge trading.
Breaks down the psychological steps needed to build strict personal rules, stop-loss discipline, and self-control.
Explores how subconscious childhood beliefs about money and risk actively interfere with financial market decisions.
A classic work recommended by top proprietary trading firms, hedge fund managers, and technical analysts.
Applicable to every market environment, whether you trade equities, derivatives, forex, or digital assets.
An indispensable masterclass in cultivating the psychological fortitude necessary for enduring trading profitability.

title: The Intelligent Investor by Benjamin Graham
description: You Become What You Think: Insights To Level Up Your Happiness, Personal Growth, Relationships, And Mental Health" Explores How Your Thoughts Shape Your Reality And Overall Well-Being. The Book Emphasizes Cultivating Positive Thinking, Self-Awareness, And Emotional Intelligence To Improve Happiness, Relationships, And Personal Growth. It Provides Practical Strategies To Overcome Negative Patterns, Manage Stress, And Build A Resilient Mindset. The Core Message: By Consciously Guiding Your Thoughts, You Can Transform Your Life, Mindset, And Interactions With Others For Lasting Fulfillment.

title: The Forest of Enchantments by Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni
description: The Forest of Enchantments is a stunning retelling of the Ramayana through the eyes of Sita—one of India’s most iconic yet misunderstood women. Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni brings Sita’s voice to life with depth, strength, and grace, revealing her courage, resilience, and inner battles as she navigates love, exile, betrayal, and duty. This novel transforms an ancient epic into a personal, intimate story about a woman who refuses to be defined by suffering alone. Beautifully written and emotionally powerful, it celebrates Sita not just as a mythological figure, but as a symbol of hope, dignity, and empowerment. A breathtaking blend of mythology, emotion, and feminine strength.

title: A Little History of the World by E.H. Gombrich
description:
A Little History of the World is a beautifully written journey through thousands of years of human history, crafted in a simple, engaging style that readers of all ages can enjoy. E. H. Gombrich tells the story of civilizations—from ancient Egypt and Greece to the Middle Ages, revolutions, and the modern world—like a captivating storyteller rather than a textbook writer. Each chapter brings historical events, cultures, and famous figures to life with clarity and warmth.
The book shows how humanity has grown, struggled, discovered, and transformed over time, making complex history feel accessible and exciting. Perfect for students, curious readers, and anyone wanting a clear introduction to world history, this classic remains one of the most beloved history books ever written.

title: Nationalism by Rabindranath Tagore
description:
Nationalism is a powerful and thought-provoking collection of essays and lectures by Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore that explores the true meaning of nationhood and humanity. Written during a time of rising political tensions across the world, the book questions blind patriotism and aggressive nationalism that divide people instead of uniting them.
Tagore offers a deeply humanistic perspective, urging societies to value compassion, culture, and universal brotherhood over narrow political identities. Through lectures delivered in Japan and the United States, he discusses the dangers of materialism, imperialism, and mechanical state power.
Blending philosophy, history, and spirituality, the writing encourages readers to think critically about freedom and responsibility.
His ideas remain strikingly relevant today, making this book a timeless reflection on global harmony and ethical citizenship.
Clear, poetic, and intellectually rich, it appeals to students, thinkers, and anyone interested in India’s intellectual heritage.
Perfect for readers of political philosophy and classic literature.
A must-read classic that inspires deeper understanding of nation, society, and humanity.

title: Mahabharata Unravelled by Ami Ganatra
description:
Mahabharata Unravelled: Lesser-Known Facets of a Well-Known History by Ami Ganatra is an authentic historical study.
Dismantles widespread popular distortions, folk myths, and cinematic exaggerations surrounding the grand ancient Indian epic.
Painstakingly researched directly from classical Sanskrit source texts, primarily the critical edition by the BORI institute.
Examines the intricate moral dilemmas, righteous decisions, and multifaceted personalities of figures like Krishna and Karna.
Delves into ancient statecraft, military ethics, philosophical duties, and the nuanced workings of Sanatana Dharma.
Provides logical, evidence-based answers to contentious events and complex ethical questions raised in the epic.
Presents scholarly depth in an engaging, lucid, and modern narrative style suitable for history lovers and general readers.
Deepens the reader's appreciation of ancient Indian culture, timeless civilizational heritage, and eternal ethical wisdom.
Widely celebrated by scholars, researchers, and book lovers for its integrity, meticulous citations, and objectivity.
A definitive, must-read Indian non-fiction book that restores the epic Mahabharata to its authentic historical grandeur.

title: The Palace of Illusions by Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni
description: The Palace of Illusions is a powerful retelling of the Indian epic Mahabharata from the perspective of Draupadi, one of its most complex and misunderstood women. The novel reimagines familiar events through her voice, revealing her emotions, desires, and inner conflicts in a world ruled by men and destiny. As Draupadi navigates love, marriage, power, and betrayal, the story explores themes of identity, resilience, and fate. Rich in cultural depth and poetic storytelling, the book offers a fresh, feminist perspective on an ancient tale. The narrative blends myth, history, and emotion with elegance and intensity. Thought-provoking and immersive, this novel is perfect for readers who enjoy mythology retold with depth, strength, and human vulnerability.

title: City of Djinns by William Dalrymple
description: City of Djinns is a rich and immersive exploration of Delhi, a city layered with centuries of history, culture, and mystery. Through vivid storytelling, William Dalrymple journeys through the seven ancient cities that make up modern Delhi, uncovering forgotten empires, ruins, legends, and living traditions. The book blends history with personal travel experiences, bringing to life saints, emperors, poets, and everyday residents who shape the city’s soul. Dalrymple captures Delhi as a place where the past constantly coexists with the present, filled with myths, djinns, and echoes of lost worlds. Written with elegance, curiosity, and deep research, the narrative is both informative and enchanting. Insightful and atmospheric, City of Djinns is perfect for readers who love history told through storytelling and cultural exploration.

title: The India Way by S. Jaishankar
description: The India Way is a clear and insightful exploration of India’s foreign policy in a rapidly changing global order. Written by India’s External Affairs Minister, S. Jaishankar, the book explains how India approaches diplomacy, security, and global partnerships based on its unique history, culture, and strategic interests. It discusses India’s relationships with major powers, neighboring countries, and international institutions, highlighting the challenges and opportunities of a multipolar world. Using real diplomatic experiences and policy insights, the author presents a realistic and pragmatic view of global politics. The book emphasizes strategic autonomy, national interest, and long-term thinking. Thoughtful and authoritative, The India Way is essential reading for anyone seeking to understand India’s role and voice on the world stage.

title: Homo Deus by Yuval Noah Harari
description:
Homo Deus: A Brief History of Tomorrow by Yuval Noah Harari envisions the bold and unpredictable future of human civilization.
Following the global triumph of Sapiens, Harari examines the transformative projects and challenges shaping the coming century.
Analyzes how humanity has largely tamed famine, plagues, and war, redirecting its ambitions toward godlike superpowers.
Explores the ethical, social, and existential dilemmas created by artificial intelligence, robotics, and genetic engineering.
Investigates the rise of 'Dataism'—a worldview where algorithmic intelligence may understand us better than we know ourselves.
Raises urgent questions about individual agency, democratic institutions, human obsolescence, and biological inequality.
Combines rigorous scientific inquiry, historical analysis, philosophy, and evolutionary theory into a thrilling narrative.
Urges readers to thoughtfully examine the societal implications of empowering machines at the expense of human consciousness.
A critically acclaimed international bestseller recommended by technological pioneers, world leaders, and global scholars.
Essential reading for anyone eager to understand the unprecedented technological revolution unfolding before our eyes.

title: Complete Chanakya Neeti by Chanakya
description: Complete Chanakya Neeti is a timeless collection of wisdom from Chanakya, one of India’s greatest thinkers, strategists, and philosophers. This book brings together his teachings on life, leadership, discipline, politics, relationships, and success—presented in simple, practical language for modern readers. Each chapter contains powerful insights that help you make better decisions, build mental strength, and navigate challenges with clarity. Chanakya’s principles, though centuries old, remain incredibly relevant today for personal growth, career success, and strategic thinking. Whether you’re seeking motivation, wisdom, or a deeper understanding of human behavior, this book is a guide to living a purposeful and intelligent life. A must-read for anyone interested in ancient Indian philosophy and practical life lessons.

title: The Last Queen by Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni
description:
The Last Queen by Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni is an electrifying historical novel centered on Maharani Jindan Kaur.
Tells the fiery, unforgettable story of the fearless kennel-keeper's daughter who became the queen of Maharaja Ranjit Singh.
Follows her dramatic rise to power as the Regent of Punjab, fiercely safeguarding the throne for her young son Dalip.
A sweeping saga of royal intrigue, battlefield courage, and unwavering resistance against British colonial expansion.
Portrays Jindan's indomitable spirit as she refuses to submit to treacherous courtiers and British imperial forces.
Divakaruni's lush, evocative prose brings the splendors, courtly rivalries, and eventual fall of the Sikh Empire vividly alive.
Restores an overlooked historical icon to her rightful place as a legendary patriot, warrior queen, and devoted mother.
Blends painstaking historical research with emotional depth, romantic passion, and breathtaking period drama.
An empowering feminist epic that resonates deeply with lovers of Indian historical fiction and warrior biographies.
An inspiring, unforgettable masterpiece that celebrates an audacious historical woman who never surrendered her dignity.

title: The Hidden Hindu 2 (Book 2 of 3) by Akshat Gupta
description: The Hidden Hindu 2 takes the mystery deeper as ancient mythology, modern science, and hidden history collide once again. Continuing the journey from the first book, the story explores immortality, forgotten warriors, and secrets buried across centuries of Indian civilization. As Prithvi moves closer to the truth, he uncovers powerful revelations that challenge everything he believes about life, death, and destiny. The narrative shifts between timelines, blending intense action with philosophical questions rooted in Hindu mythology. Each chapter raises the stakes, revealing shocking connections between the past and the present. Fast-paced, thought-provoking, and rich in mythological detail, this sequel keeps readers hooked and sets the stage perfectly for the final chapter of the trilogy.

title: The Song of Achilles by Madeline Miller
description: The Song of Achilles is a breathtaking retelling of the Trojan War, told through the eyes of Patroclus, the exiled prince who becomes the closest companion of the legendary warrior Achilles. As their bond deepens into love, the story explores loyalty, desire, and the cost of destiny in a world shaped by gods and prophecy. Set against the backdrop of epic battles and divine interference, the novel reimagines ancient myth with emotional intimacy and lyrical beauty. Madeline Miller brings tenderness and humanity to legendary figures, highlighting the vulnerability behind heroism. The narrative balances romance with tragedy, leading inevitably toward a heartbreaking conclusion. Powerful, poetic, and unforgettable, this novel is a must-read for lovers of mythology, historical fiction, and deeply emotional storytelling.

title: The Immortals of Meluha (Book 1 of The Shiva Trilogy) by Amish Tripathi
description:
The Immortals of Meluha is the first book in the bestselling Shiva Trilogy by Amish Tripathi. Set in 1900 BC, the story reimagines Lord Shiva as a courageous tribal leader from Tibet who is invited to the prosperous land of Meluha, a near-perfect empire built on the ideals of Lord Ram. When Shiva arrives, a mysterious event turns his throat blue, leading the people of Meluha to believe he is the legendary Neelkanth—the prophesied savior destined to destroy evil.
As tensions rise between the Suryavanshis, Chandravanshis, and the feared Nagas, Shiva is drawn into a world of war, politics, love, and destiny. What begins as a battle against a perceived enemy gradually becomes a deeper quest to understand the true nature of good and evil. Filled with action, mythology, philosophy, and unforgettable characters, this gripping novel offers a fresh and compelling interpretation of one of India’s most revered deities.

title: Tamil Edition - Chanakya Neethi | Chanakya's Wisdom on Strategy, Leadership & Life
description:
Discover the timeless wisdom of Chanakya Neethi, a collection of teachings and principles traditionally associated with Chanakya, the ancient Indian philosopher, teacher, and strategist. This Tamil edition brings together insights on practical wisdom, leadership, relationships, discipline, and decision-making.
Through its teachings, the book explores how intelligence, patience, self-control, and careful observation can help readers navigate everyday challenges. It offers perspectives on human behaviour, personal conduct, strategic thinking, and the importance of making thoughtful choices in life.
Whether you are interested in ancient Indian philosophy, leadership principles, or personal development, Chanakya Neethi offers lessons that readers can reflect on and apply to modern situations.

title: Why Bharat Matters by S. Jaishankar
description: Why Bharat Matters is a powerful and timely exploration of India’s role in a rapidly changing world. Dr. S. Jaishankar, India’s External Affairs Minister, examines the nation’s civilizational identity, strategic priorities, and rising global influence. The book explains why understanding “Bharat” — its history, culture, and worldview — is crucial for navigating today’s geopolitical challenges. Through sharp analysis and real-world insights, Jaishankar discusses diplomacy, national security, global order, and India’s pursuit of self-reliance. Thought-provoking and authoritative, Why Bharat Matters offers a compelling narrative of India's evolving position on the world stage. A must-read for anyone interested in politics, foreign policy, and India’s future.

title: The Secret of the Nagas (Book 2 of The Shiva Trilogy) by Amish Tripathi
description:
The Secret of the Nagas is the thrilling second book in The Shiva Trilogy by Amish Tripathi. Picking up right where The Immortals of Meluha ends, the story follows Shiva as he sets out to uncover the truth behind the mysterious Nagas—an enigmatic race believed to be the enemies of Meluha. As he journeys across ancient India, Shiva encounters shocking revelations that challenge everything he once believed about good, evil, loyalty, and destiny.
What begins as a quest for revenge soon transforms into a deeper search for truth. Along the way, Shiva uncovers long-hidden secrets about the Nagas, his family, and the powerful forces shaping the fate of the land. Filled with action, mystery, emotional twists, and mythological intrigue, the novel expands the rich world of the Shiva Trilogy while exploring themes of acceptance, leadership, justice, and the complexity of human nature.

title: Aghori: An Untold Story by Mayur Kalbag
description: Aghori: An Untold Story takes readers deep into one of India’s most mysterious and misunderstood spiritual traditions. With rare insights, powerful storytelling, and extensive research, the book uncovers the beliefs, rituals, and philosophy of the Aghori sect—known for their intense practices and unconventional path to liberation. It explores their worldview, their relationship with death, their pursuit of fearlessness, and the spiritual logic behind practices often judged by society. More than a study of mysticism, it is a journey into the human mind, the search for truth, and the extremes of devotion. Thought-provoking and eye-opening, the book challenges stereotypes and reveals a side of Indian spirituality rarely discussed.

title: Mahagatha: 100 Tales from the Puranas by Utkarsh Patel
description: Mahagatha: 100 Tales from the Puranas is a captivating collection that retells ancient Indian myths with freshness, depth, and contemporary relevance. Drawing from various Puranas, the book presents one hundred interconnected stories about gods, demons, sages, humans, and cosmic events that shaped Indian mythology. Each tale explores themes of dharma, desire, power, devotion, and moral ambiguity, revealing the many shades of divine and human nature. Satyarth Nayak’s storytelling is engaging and accessible, making complex myths easy to understand without losing their philosophical richness. The book highlights lesser-known stories alongside familiar legends, offering new perspectives on well-known characters. Thought-provoking and immersive, it invites readers to question, reflect, and rediscover mythology beyond black-and-white morality. Perfect for mythology lovers, Mahagatha is both an entertaining read and a deep exploration of timeless wisdom.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind by Yuval Noah Harari
description: Sapiens is a groundbreaking exploration of how humans evolved from insignificant apes into the most dominant species on Earth. Yuval Noah Harari takes readers on a sweeping journey through history—covering the Cognitive Revolution, the rise of agriculture, the birth of religion, the foundations of society, and the rapid technological changes shaping our future. With clarity and bold insight, he explains how shared myths, cooperation, money, politics, and culture shaped civilizations. The book challenges everything you think you know about humanity and reveals the hidden forces driving our world. Deeply thought-provoking, gripping, and transformative, Sapiens offers a new lens through which to understand who we are and where we might be headed.

title: The Hidden Hindu (Book 1 of 3) by Akshat Gupta
description:
The Hidden Hindu is an exciting mythological thriller by Akshat Gupta that blends ancient Indian mythology with modern storytelling. The novel revolves around a mysterious man named Om Shastri, who is believed to possess extraordinary knowledge about historical events and hidden secrets connected to Hindu mythology.
As researchers investigate his mysterious identity, shocking truths about immortality, ancient warriors, and forgotten legends begin to emerge. The story connects mythology, history, science, and suspense in a gripping narrative that keeps readers engaged throughout the journey.
Inspired by epics like the Mahabharata and Hindu scriptures, the book introduces powerful characters, hidden secrets, and thrilling twists. Akshat Gupta’s engaging writing style and fast-paced storytelling make it an enjoyable read for mythology and thriller lovers alike.
Filled with mystery, adventure, and spiritual elements, The Hidden Hindu offers a unique reading experience that explores the timeless connection between the ancient world and modern society.

title: The Oath of the Vayuputras (Book 3 of The Shiva Trilogy) by Amish Tripathi
description:
The Oath of the Vayuputras is the epic conclusion to The Shiva Trilogy by Amish Tripathi. After uncovering shocking truths about the Nagas and the source of many of the kingdom’s troubles, Shiva embarks on his most challenging mission yet—to confront the true evil threatening the world. As alliances shift and ancient secrets come to light, he must make difficult choices that will determine the fate of millions.
Driven by his unwavering sense of justice, Shiva gathers powerful allies and prepares for a decisive battle that will test his courage, wisdom, and beliefs. Packed with action, suspense, emotion, and profound philosophical questions, this gripping finale explores the consequences of power, the meaning of duty, and the eternal struggle between good and evil.

title: Sita: Warrior of Mithila by Amish Tripathi
description:
Sita: Warrior of Mithila by Amish Tripathi is the action-packed second installment in the bestselling Ram Chandra Series.
Reimagines the revered Sita not merely as an obedient princess, but as a fearless warrior, strategist, and statesman.
Follows an abandoned infant discovered in a barren field who rises through grit to become the Prime Minister of Mithila.
Showcases Sita's martial mastery, political acumen, and steadfast commitment to revitalizing a corrupt and divided land.
Amish seamlessly weaves ancient Indian mythology, thrilling geopolitical intrigue, and fast-paced martial battles.
Explores timeless civilizational questions of Dharma, gender equality, righteous governance, and moral leadership.
A multi-million-copy national bestseller that captured the imagination of mythological fiction enthusiasts nationwide.
Features cinematic storytelling, complex character arcs, and rich worldbuilding that keep readers hooked throughout.
A must-read for fans of the Shiva Trilogy, epic historical fantasy, and reimagined mythological adventures.
An empowering, unforgettable tribute that celebrates the divine feminine spirit with boundless energy and reverence.

title: Raavan: Enemy of Aryavarta (Book 3 of 3) by Amish Tripathi
description: Raavan: Enemy of Aryavarta is a gripping, intense retelling of the legend of Raavan, one of Indian mythology’s most complex and misunderstood figures. Amish Tripathi explores Raavan’s life from childhood to his rise as a feared ruler—revealing the pain, ambition, brilliance, and darkness that shaped him. This is the story of a man blessed with extraordinary talent yet haunted by deep emotional wounds. Through power, love, loss, and revenge, Raavan transforms into the legendary antagonist we know from the Ramayana. Rich in world-building, emotion, and moral depth, the book invites readers to see the epic villain through a human lens. A thrilling, powerful, and thought-provoking read that expands the Ram Chandra Series universe.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo by Taylor Jenkins Reid
description:
Behind the glamour lies a shocking truth.
The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo is a captivating tale of fame, love, and sacrifice set in Old Hollywood. As a reclusive icon reveals the story of her seven marriages, secrets unravel about ambition, identity, and a once-in-a-lifetime love. Glamorous, emotional, and unforgettable—perfect for readers who love powerful women, scandal, and heart-wrenching romance. 🎥❤️📘

title: Haunting Adeline (Book 1 of 2) by H.D. Carlton
description:
A love story written in shadows.
Haunting Adeline is a dark, addictive romance filled with obsession, danger, and psychological tension. When a stalker-and-prey game turns into something far more twisted, secrets surface and boundaries blur. Intense, haunting, and impossible to forget, this book is perfect for readers who crave dark romance, morally grey characters, and stories that push emotional limits. ⚠️🖤📘

title: Nothing Like the Movies by Lynn Painter
description:
Real love is messier—and better—than the movies.
Nothing Like the Movies is a fun, heartfelt rom-com about love, timing, and second chances. As old feelings resurface and emotions collide, the story proves that real relationships don’t follow a perfect script. Sweet, emotional, and laugh-out-loud romantic, this book is perfect for readers who love college romance, friends-to-lovers vibes, and stories that feel beautifully real. 🎬💖📘

title: King of Pride (Book 2 of 5) by Ana Huang
description:
Opposites attract—and collide.
King of Pride is a steamy grumpy-sunshine romance between a disciplined billionaire and a bold, free-spirited woman who challenges everything he believes. What starts as resistance turns into undeniable chemistry, emotional growth, and a love neither saw coming. Witty, passionate, and addictive—perfect for readers who love strong characters, slow-burn tension, and heart-melting romance. 💖📘

title: Hunting Adeline (Book 2 of 2) by H.D. Carlton
description:
Dark. Dangerous. Unforgettable.
Hunting Adeline is a gripping dark romance-thriller where obsession, trauma, and survival collide. As Adeline faces her darkest fears, a ruthless protector emerges—blurring the line between salvation and obsession. Intense, raw, and emotionally charged, this book is for readers who crave high-stakes suspense, morally grey characters, and a love that defies every rule. ⚠️🔥📘

title: The Things We Leave Unfinished by Rebecca Yarros
description:
The Things We Leave Unfinished by Rebecca Yarros is an emotional, sweeping dual-timeline historical and contemporary romance.
From the #1 New York Times bestselling author of Fourth Wing comes a heartbreaking tale of enduring love and sacrifice.
Follows Georgia Stanton as she retreats to her great-grandmother's countryside estate to rebuild her life following a divorce.
Enter Noah Harrison, a bestselling author hired to complete the unfinished final manuscript left by Georgia's grandmother.
Alternates between their modern slow-burn tension and a perilous World War II romance between an American pilot and a British lady.
Overflowing with deep passion, wartime danger, long-buried family secrets, and the devastating emotional scars of conflict.
Rebecca Yarros delivers flawless pacing, deeply textured characters, and a shocking plot twist that leaves readers weeping.
A massive BookTok sensation and international bestseller praised for its lyrical prose and profound romantic depth.
Captures the extraordinary courage required to open your heart to love when everything around you is falling apart.
An unforgettable, breathtaking romance masterpiece that lingers in your memory long after the final chapter ends.

title: Daydream by Hannah Grace
description:
Daydream by Hannah Grace is the heartwarming, swoon-worthy third novel in the smash-hit Maple Hills romance series.
Follows charismatic college hockey captain Henry Turner and introverted bookworm Halle Jacobs in an irresistible romance.
Overwhelmed by new team leadership responsibilities, Henry struggles to balance intense collegiate hockey with challenging academics.
Halle is an ambitious creative writing student facing crippling writer's block while trying to draft her debut romance book.
When their paths collide, they strike an unexpected mutual deal: Halle tutors Henry, while Henry helps her experience life.
Features the beloved golden-retriever hero dynamic, witty banter, comforting emotional intimacy, and slow-burn chemistry.
Explores relatable themes of neurodiversity, academic pressure, self-discovery, and overcoming performance anxiety.
Hannah Grace crafts a cozy, joyful campus atmosphere filled with supportive friendships and genuine romantic warmth.
An absolute must-read for lovers of Icebreaker, Wildfire, sports romance books, and feel-good contemporary love stories.
A delightful, emotionally satisfying romantic comedy that leaves readers completely charmed and smiling throughout.

title: Thank You for Leaving by Rithvik Singh
description: Thank You for Leaving is a deeply emotional poetry collection that explores love, heartbreak, loss, and the quiet strength that comes after letting go. Through simple yet powerful verses, the author captures the pain of broken relationships and the healing that follows acceptance. Each poem feels personal and relatable, giving words to emotions many struggle to express. The book gently reminds readers that endings can be painful, but they are often necessary for growth. Filled with raw honesty and comforting reflections, it offers solace to anyone dealing with heartbreak or emotional change. This collection is perfect for readers who find healing, hope, and self-discovery through poetry and introspective writing.

title: King of Wrath (Book 1 of 5) by Ana Huang
description:
Power, passion, and a marriage neither of them wanted.
King of Wrath is a sizzling billionaire romance where a ruthless tycoon is forced into an arranged marriage with a woman he never planned to love. What begins as a cold contract soon ignites into intense chemistry, secrets, and emotional depth. Dark, addictive, and irresistibly romantic—perfect for readers who crave enemies-to-lovers tension, strong characters, and a love that burns against all odds. 🔥📘

title: This Thing Called Love BY Deblina Bhattacharyya
description:
This Thing Called Love is a heartwarming contemporary romance that explores love, healing, friendship, and self-discovery. The story follows Amaira, an ambitious aspiring chef, and Deven, a quiet and thoughtful writer, whose lives become connected through an arranged marriage.
Initially brought together by circumstances rather than choice, the two struggle to understand each other and adjust to their new relationship. As they spend time together in the beautiful city of Paris, an unexpected bond begins to develop between them.
However, past wounds, misunderstandings, and emotional baggage threaten to keep them apart. Through moments of joy, vulnerability, and personal growth, Amaira and Deven learn valuable lessons about trust, acceptance, and the true meaning of love.
Filled with emotional depth, relatable characters, and heartfelt storytelling, this novel beautifully captures the complexities of modern relationships. Perfect for romance lovers, This Thing Called Love is an inspiring story about second chances, personal growth, and discovering love where you least expect it.

title: U n Me... It's Complicated BY Aditya Nigghot
description:
U n Me... It's Complicated is a touching contemporary romance that explores the complexities of modern relationships, love, friendship, and emotional connections. The story follows two individuals whose lives become deeply intertwined as they navigate misunderstandings, expectations, heartbreak, and the challenges of finding true love.
Filled with relatable emotions and realistic situations, the novel captures the ups and downs that often define relationships in today's world. As the characters struggle with their feelings and personal choices, they discover important lessons about trust, communication, and self-discovery.
The book combines romance, drama, and heartfelt moments to create an engaging reading experience for young adults and romance lovers. Mansi Gupta's simple and expressive writing style makes the story easy to connect with and enjoyable to read.
Perfect for readers who enjoy emotional love stories and relationship-based fiction, U n Me... It's Complicated is a compelling journey of love, growth, and understanding that reminds us that relationships are rarely simple, but always worth exploring.

title: King of Envy (Book 5 of 5) by Ana Huang
description:
Desire turns dangerous when envy takes over.
King of Envy is a dark, addictive billionaire romance filled with forbidden attraction, obsession, and emotional intensity. When ambition and jealousy collide with irresistible chemistry, lines blur and hearts are tested. Steamy, angsty, and impossible to put down—perfect for readers who crave morally grey heroes, high-stakes passion, and love that burns against all rules. 🔥💚📘

title: It Starts with Us (Book 2 of 2) by Colleen Hoover
description: It Starts With Us picks up where It Ends With Us left off ï¿½ this time told from both Lily and Atlass perspectives. As Lily begins to rebuild her life and raise her daughter, a second chance with Atlas seems possibleï¿½ but Ryle, her ex-husband, remains a looming presence. This deeply emotional sequel focuses on healing, healthy love, and new beginnings, contrasting the toxic relationship of the past with the gentle love she rediscovers. Its a story of choosing love without pain, and rewriting your story on your own terms.

title: Twisted Hate (Book 3 of 4) by Ana Huang
description: Twisted Hate is a fiery, addictive enemies-to-lovers romance that follows Josh Chen, a driven medical student, and Jules Ambrose, a bold, sharp-tongued law student who has always gotten under his skin. Their mutual dislike runs deep—until one night changes everything. What starts as tension and verbal sparring soon becomes a dangerously irresistible attraction neither of them can deny. As Josh and Jules dance between passion and rivalry, secrets from their pasts threaten to break them apart. Filled with steam, banter, emotional depth, and Ana Huang’s signature twists, Twisted Hate is a gripping addition to the Twisted universe that will keep readers hooked from start to finish.

title: King of Greed (Book 3 of 5) by Ana Huang
description:
He had everything—except the woman he loved.
King of Greed is an emotional, second-chance billionaire romance about ambition, regret, and fighting for love before it’s too late. When a marriage cracks under the weight of success and neglect, old feelings resurface with intense passion and heartbreak. Deep, angsty, and irresistibly romantic—perfect for readers who love powerful emotions, redemption arcs, and love that demands everything. 💔🔥📘

title: Can We Be Strangers Again? by Novoneel Chakraborty
description: Can We Be Strangers Again? is a heart-touching, emotional romance that explores love, heartbreak, and the longing to start over. Centered around Advik and Aarna, two people once deeply in love, the novel follows their journey after a painful breakup that leaves both of them shattered. When life unexpectedly forces their paths to cross again, old memories resurface along with the questions they never dared to ask. As they confront their past and the people they have become, the story beautifully captures the ache of nostalgia, the weight of unresolved emotions, and the delicate hope of second chances. Honest, relatable, and filled with raw emotions, this book resonates with anyone who has ever loved and lost.

title: I Cannot Say Goodbye to You by Novoneel Chakraborty
description:
I Cannot Say Goodbye to You is an emotional romance that captures the ache of love that refuses to fade.
The story explores two hearts bound by memories, timing, and words left unsaid.
As life pulls them in different directions, emotions linger, growing heavier with every passing moment.
Love, regret, and longing intertwine as the characters struggle between holding on and letting go.
The narrative gently reflects on relationships that change us forever.
Each page carries quiet pain, warmth, and vulnerability.
A heartfelt read for anyone who has loved deeply and found goodbye to be the hardest word.

title: Attitude Is Everything by Jeff Keller
description: Attitude Is Everything By Jeff Keller Is A Motivational Book That Shows How A Positive Attitude Can Transform Your Life. It Explains That Thoughts Shape Actions, And Actions Determine Success. The Book Is Divided Into Three Parts Thinking, Speaking, And Acting Each Teaching How To Develop A Winning Mindset. Keller Emphasizes Self-Belief, Gratitude, And Persistence In Overcoming Challenges. The Key Message Is That By Changing Your Attitude, You Can Change Your Future And Achieve Both Personal And Professional Success.

title: Twisted Games (Book 2 of 4) by Ana Huang
description: Twisted Games is a slow-burn, forbidden royal romance that follows Princess Bridget von Ascheberg and her stoic, dangerously protective bodyguard, Rhys Larsen. Duty, power, and strict rules keep them apart—but the chemistry between them becomes impossible to ignore. As Bridget prepares for a crown she never wanted and Rhys battles the demons from his past, the two are drawn into a passionate, high-stakes love that threatens everything. Full of tension, angst, and explosive attraction, Ana Huang delivers a story filled with political intrigue, emotional depth, and heart-stopping twists.
